run_subprocess_command: run a command via gtest_test_utils.Subprocess and return 1 if killed by a signal or 0 otherwise
test_break_on_failure_default: test the default behavior of gtest_break_on_failure_unittest_ without any env var or flag set
test_break_on_failure_env_var: test gtest_break_on_failure using the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable set to 0 or 1
test_break_on_failure_flag: test gtest_break_on_failure using the --gtest_break_on_failure command line flag set to 0 or 1
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable
